latest_release.body:
# Posterizarr 4.0.2 **Maintenance release fixing custom overlay image uploads and updating frontend `i18next` dependencies.**

☕ Support on Ko-fi · 💬 Discord · 🎨 Community Gallery Repo · ⚡ 5-Minute Quickstart · Documentation · Dynamic Overlays Guide · Web UI Guide

Posterizarr 4.0.2 is a quick patch release following 4.0.1 that fixes custom PNG/image overlay uploads in Dynamic Overlays and updates frontend i18n dependencies to address a Dependabot security advisory. > ☕ **Enjoying Posterizarr?** Posterizarr is free and open source. If it makes your library look great, consider **[supporting Posterizarr on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/R6R81S6SC)**, starring the repo, or sharing your own presets in **[posterizarr-community](https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr-community)**! --- ## 🐛 Bug Fixes - **Custom Overlay Image Uploads (`#707`):** Fixed a `NameError` during image validation in the per-library custom image overlay upload endpoint (`webui/backend/main.py`) that caused uploads to fail with `Uploaded file is not a valid image.` Thanks to @PttCodingMan! ## 🔒 Security & Dependencies - **Frontend i18n Packages:** Upgraded `i18next` (`^23.16.8` → `^26.7.2`), `react-i18next` (`^13.5.0` → `^17.1.13`), and `i18next-browser-languagedetector` (`^7.2.2` → `^8.3.1`) to patch the `i18next < 26.3.4` `deepExtend` vulnerability reported by Dependabot. --- ## What's Changed * Fix NameError on image upload validation in overlay upload endpoint by @PttCodingMan in https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr/pull/707 * Sync Main2Dev by @fscorrupt in https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr/pull/708 * Release 4.0.2: Custom overlay upload fix & i18next security update by @fscorrupt in https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr/pull/709 ## New Contributors * @PttCodingMan made their first contribution in https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr/pull/707 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr/compare/4.0.1...4.0.2

detail.readme:
Automated Artwork & Native Dynamic Overlays for Plex, Jellyfin & Emby

Generate consistent posters, seasons, backgrounds, title cards, and collections — while keeping your clean source artwork untouched on disk.

       

Documentation »  ·  Installation  ·  Dynamic Overlays  ·  Artwork Showcase  ·  Community Gallery



🎨 Automated Artwork
Generate matching posters, seasons, title cards, backgrounds, collections, and clearlogos via TMDb, TheTVDB, Fanart.tv, and Plex. 		✨ Native Dynamic Overlays
Import Kometa-style YAML, preview badges live, share portable bundles via the Community Gallery, and composite in memory — no extra container, clean sources untouched.
📺 Plex, Jellyfin & Emby
Direct sync, real-time WebSocket plugins with optional Plex Direct Sync, AniMetaFill, Asset Title Review, local IMDb ratings, and Plex Image Cleanup. (Silo: experimental) 		⚡ Web UI & Automation
All-in-one Web UI with guided setup, built-in Scheduler, native Tautulli, Sonarr, and Radarr webhooks, Testing Mode, and safe Dry Run.

🚀 Get Started

Docker Compose, Unraid, PowerShell guides, Web UI walkthroughs, and API references live on the dedicated docs site.
